applicability.condition: This fingerprint identifies a read-only audit snapshot only. It authorizes no mutation now or later. Persisting terms, confirming candidates, changing classifications, deploying a new runtime, or any other source revision invalidates this snapshot for apply purposes. A new post-decision preview and a new SHA-256 fingerprint are mandatory before SCA-04 approval can be requested.

applyScopeNote: No apply scope is authorized by this snapshot. Any future apply requires a new post-decision preview with its own SHA-256 fingerprint and a separate approval; this field exists only to prevent the removed futureApplyScope from being mistaken for authorized scope.

The excluded Silver Research pair contributes 0.

nextActionSequence: 1. Package and deploy the already-reviewed SCA-02 runtime through a separately authorized deployment.
2. Operator selects the active-year term configuration.
3. Operator confirms or rejects the grouped curriculum candidates and resolves remaining classifications/rotations.
4. Run a fresh read-only SCA-03 post-decision preview.
5. Generate a new fingerprint binding the persisted term revision and complete approved requirement set.
6. Request approval for that new fingerprint.
7. Only after approval may SCA-04 apply/integrate the pinned state.
